evidence: vc_202_012_mastery (tests/capability_bus.rs): T-DEEPSEEK-95 built the typed CapabilityBus — discovery, permission/timeout/cost enforcement — in crates/susi-core/src/capability_bus.rs, but it had no production caller: CapabilityRegistry::typed_bus was reachable only from its own tests. Fixed by T-INTELLIBITZWT20261005035445-2: crates/susi-core/src/registry.rs adds CapabilityRegistry::dispatch_capability, a real caller that resolves a descriptor from the live typed_bus snapshot and invokes the actually-registered tool, already MAC-enforced and evidence-captured by register_tool, through the bus's permission/timeout/cost contract. Exposed on 'susi os capabilities' to discover the live global registry's A2A/MCP/HTTP/adapter catalog, and 'susi os capabilities invoke' to dispatch. The cited test registers a real Tool on a fresh CapabilityRegistry, discovers it through typed_bus, and dispatches it end to end with a passing invocation, a permission denial, a zero-timeout refusal, and an unknown-id refusal, all through dispatch_capability, not a synthetic in-memory catalog. Manually smoke-tested through the built susi binary too: discover lists 263 real registered agent/tool/provider capabilities, and invoke on an unregistered id returns UnknownCapability cleanly.
missing: Only the Mcp (tool) surface can be dispatched today — A2a (agent) and Adapter (provider) capabilities discover through typed_bus() but dispatch_capability refuses them with InvalidDescriptor, since AgentCapability/Provider have different invocation signatures than Tool::execute and bridging them is unscoped work. HTTP capabilities are registered as Adapter-surfaced providers today (no distinct Http registration path), so the bus's own Http surface has no registry-backed discovery source either, only the synthetic fixture in the bus's own tests. cost_micros is hardcoded to 0 for every typed_bus() descriptor and dispatch outcome — there is still no real per-capability cost model, so budget enforcement is exercised (zero vs non-zero ceilings) but not meaningfully attributed yet.
